title: Know what the answer could not reach
statement: As a developer, I can see every change the answer could not connect to a story, so a short list of tests never reads as proof that the rest is safe.
overview: Proposed addition, and what makes the answer usable: people can only figure out what to run if they can see what it missed. On v0.6.0 to v0.7.0, 1,378 of 17,802 changed lines reach a story. Trevor's direction is that the tool answers and teams judge, so it never calls the answer trustworthy or not.

acceptance_criteria.statement: When asked about a range, the answer lists changed lines that reach no story, with a count, every time.
Asked about a line that reaches no story, the answer says so, and does not read as no tests needed.
It also lists affected stories and criteria with no catalog entry.
It exits 3 when anything is listed and 0 only when the recorded links reach all of it, as `review test-plan` does.
The output says the list reflects only recorded links, and never says it is safe to skip the full suite.
A fix with no story appears here as unmapped change, and a release containing it can still go out.
